title: Aurora 2.0: Beyond the Horizon
description: Aurora 2.0 is a hackathon that brings together satellite datasets, AI-powered analysis, and practical problem-solving to address pressing challenges in space tech and geospatial analytics.

important: Every team has to register online on the official Techfest website for the competition.
A Team ID will be allocated on registration for future references.
The decision of the organizers or judges is final and binding.
others: Team size: 2–6.
3 Stages: Stage 1 (50%) Remote Sensing Hackathon (online); Stage 2 (15%) Quiz on space and data science (offline); Stage 3 (35%) Presentation (offline).
Mode: Online hackathon; Offline Quiz + Presentation.
Teams must maintain a public GitHub repository.
At least one team member must join the WhatsApp group (link).
Submit the public repository link as per instructions (link to be made).

rounds.name: Quiz on space and data science

timeline.title: Hackathon Launch
timeline.description: Release of problem statement and dataset. Teams begin working.

timeline.title: Hackathon Submission Deadline
timeline.description: Teams submit complete solutions for evaluation.

timeline.title: Shortlist Announcement
timeline.description: Top 8 teams announced for onsite stages.

timeline.title: Technical Quiz (Stage 2)
timeline.description: One-hour quiz on astronomy, remote sensing, and geospatial data science.

timeline.title: Final Presentations (Stage 3)
timeline.description: Onsite presentations before the jury at CLT, IIT Dharwad.

deliverables: Public GitHub repository with code in a Jupyter Notebook (well-commented).
README with instructions to run the code.
Report detailing thought process, experiments, research, and future scope.
comments: For offline events - accommodation shall be limited/exclusive; keep an eye on website.

title: Protocraft
description: Theme-based mechanical design challenge—sketch, model, simulate, and present your engineering solution.

important: Every team has to register online on the official Techfest website for the competition.
A Team ID will be allocated on registration for future references.
The decision of the organizers or judges is final and binding.
others: Individual or teams up to 3.
All design work must be original and created during the event.
Any CAD and simulation tools allowed.
Submission: Final CAD model (STEP/SLDPRT/SLDASM/STL) + 2-page design explanation (reasoning, performance advantage).
Shortlisted participants present (7 min + 3 min Q&A).
Disqualification: plagiarism, AI-generated CAD, misrepresentation, no-show in presentation.
Only top 12 teams shortlisted from online round; judged on Functionality, Creativity, Theme relevance.

comments: For offline events - accommodation shall be limited/exclusive; keep an eye on website.

title: DevHack 7.0
description: PARSEC’s 30-hour flagship hackathon to prototype impactful solutions, mentored and judged by industry experts.

important: Every team must register on the official PARSEC website.
A Team ID will be allocated upon registration.
Organizers’/judges’ decisions are final.
Top 33–34 teams shortlisted from online round.
others: Eligibility: Any UG/PG students across India.
Duration: 30 hours + 3 hours presentation.
Mode: Offline.
Carry college ID cards; open-source tools allowed; no plagiarism or misconduct.

format: Preliminary Phase (Online Submission): report on approach/methodology.
Hackathon Phase (Offline – 30 hours): build working prototype; deliverables include GitHub repo and demo video.
Final Presentation Round (Offline – 3 hours): evaluation on innovation, creativity, applicability.

title: Veni Vidi Veci (VVV)
description: CTF covering cryptography, forensics, reversing, web, OSINT and more. Jeopardy style with dynamic scoring.

important: Register on the official Techfest website.
Team ID issued upon registration.
Organizers’/judges’ decisions are final.
others: Eligibility: Any UG/PG worldwide; Prize eligibility: UG/PG in India.
Team size: up to 3.
Duration: 48 hours; Style: Jeopardy; Mode: Online.
Use same email as Unstop for CTF account.
No attacking infrastructure; report vulnerabilities responsibly.
No flag sharing; dynamic scoring enabled; flags format: parsec{flag_text}.
AI tools allowed responsibly and ethically.

notes: Prizes reserved only for current residents of India

title: Algostrike
description: Individual competitive programming contest (single round, 2 hours).

important: Register on the official Techfest website.
Participant ID issued upon registration.
Organizers’/judges’ decisions are final.
others: Strictly individual; no team participation.
No copying or AI-generated code; plagiarism leads to disqualification.
Duration 2 hours; rule changes at organizers’ discretion.
On-site only; remote not permitted.

format: 6–8 problems of varying difficulty; ranked by problems solved then by lowest cumulative time.

notes: Prizes reserved only for current residents of India

title: BitHunt
description: Two-round technical treasure hunt blending coding, aptitude, and on-campus clue solving.

important: Register on Unstop.
Team ID allocated upon registration.
Teams must be 3–4 members from the same college.
No internet during online round (Unstop Smart Hire app).
Organizers’ decisions are final; misconduct or plagiarism leads to disqualification.
others: Round 1: 10 aptitude + 10 DSA questions; 25 minutes; online.
Round 2: On-campus Bit Chase with zones, bases, QR codes, and live War Room coding.
Hidden gems for bonus or steal; scoreboard live in War Room.
Elimination after each zone for lowest-scoring teams.

notes: Certificate of participation for all participants

comments: Get ready for the Ultimate Bit Chase !

title: Gringotts
description: Finance workshop exploring quantitative finance and algo trading.

others: Full attendance required for certificate.
Registrations limited to 125 participants.

title: Design Playground
description: Gamified design thinking workshop with interactive activities, quick challenges, and team tasks.

others: Full attendance required for certificate.
Materials provided on-site.
Team formation (if applicable) during the workshop.

title: Singularity: Build. Evolve. Converge.
description: 30-hour agentic AI hackathon building autonomous multi-agent systems with tool use and real-time decision-making.
format: Hackathon (Offline – 30 hours): build and refine solutions; deliver repo and demo video.
Final Presentation (Offline – 3 hours): judged on innovation, technical depth, applicability, autonomy.

additional: Solution draft required with registration (deadline slightly extended)

title: Trumble (Invest, Grow and Prosper)
description: Mock stock market competition on StockGro with simulated funds and real-time market dynamics.

important: Register on the official Techfest website.
Team ID allocated upon registration.
Organizers’/judges’ decisions are final.
others: Only trades on StockGro are valid; follow StockGro rules.
Trades in multiples of 5; min 1 and max 10 trades/day.
Portfolio <= 50% of initial value at end of day leads to disqualification.
No highly volatile/pump-and-dump stocks; no NIFTY trades.
Champion determined by highest portfolio valuation on 2026-01-23.
guidelines: No registration fee; online; 5-day trading period; individual participation.

comments: Accommodation note applies only to offline events.

title: Build a Bot 3.0
description: Flagship robotics challenge focusing on Perception and Motion Control. Two tracks: Junior and Senior.
format: Round 1: Online qualifier (design/simulate/propose). Top 10 per track qualify.
Round 2: Onsite Buildathon (24 hours) with hardware and new PS released a week prior.
eligibility: Open to students from recognized colleges/universities across India.
Teams up to 4; inter-college teams allowed.
Register for only one problem statement (Junior or Senior).

others: Carry college ID for onsite.
No plagiarism or misconduct.
Organizers may modify rules/format/evaluation if necessary.

title: StarQuest
description: On-campus astronomy quiz (1–2 hours) with prizes and workshop access for top scorers. Followed by optional stargazing night.

important: Register via official Parsec 6.0 website.
Participant ID issued upon registration.
Organizers’/judges’ decisions are final.
others: Individual event; open to UG/PG across India; on-site presence required; timed round; no cheating; rule modifications possible.

inKind: Free workshop access for top scorers

title: Synapse: The NeuroTech Challenge
description: EMG-based dual-mode prosthetic control using Myoware 2.0 sensors: continuous proportional control and discrete gesture recognition.
format: Phase 1 (Online): Submit trained model predictions on hidden ground-truth test dataset.
Phase 2 (Offline, top 5): Live demo with EMG streaming to trained model; control prosthetic arm/simulation; optional gaming interface.

inKind: Exclusive Merch for winning team members

title: Astrophotography Workshop
description: Hands-on night-sky photography: telescope-mounted DSLR imaging, framing, exposure, and basic post-processing.

others: Register via official Parsec 6.0 website; full attendance required for certificate.
Equipment provided on-site; bringing your own DSLR is optional.
Slots limited; first-come, first-served.
